content.text: I want to change some of these lucide icons, how do I re-map them?
I’ll trace the icon lookup in the current TinyMCE renderer and its nearest tests, then I can point you to the exact remapping surface and any regeneration or test step it requires.

The remapping is centralized in `ICON_ALIASES` in the file you have open: TinyMCE’s icon key maps to a Pantoken/Lucide token name, and unknown names fall back to `circle-question-mark`. I’m checking the focused test now so I can show the expected validation pattern and the distinction between toolbar icons and the separate icon picker.

Edit [`renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts`](renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts), specifically `ICON_ALIASES`:

```ts
const ICON_ALIASES: Record<string, string> = {
  bold: "text",
  close: "circle-x",
  "action-next": "chevron-right",
};
```

The left side is the TinyMCE icon name; the right side is the Pantoken/Lucide token name.

One subtlety: direct token names take priority over aliases:

```ts
const pantokenName = pantokenIcons.has(tinymceIconName)
  ? tinymceIconName
  : ICON_ALIASES[tinymceIconName];
```

So aliases only affect names without an existing matching token. To remap an existing icon such as `bold`, change this resolver to prefer aliases:

```ts
const pantokenName = ICON_ALIASES[tinymceIconName] ?? tinymceIconName;
```

Then run:

```sh
vp test renderers/tinymce/tests/icon-pack.test.ts
```
